properties.description: Before replacing an export file, compare what is on disk against what is about to be written and answer one question: would this DROP nodes or edges the file holds? The file where this seat left it is the silent fast path (one hash comparison against a marker in <graph-path>.sync.json); a file that moved but loses nothing is allowed and reported; a write that would delete somebody else's work is refused, naming the ids and the three-step remedy, overridable only by an explicit accept_divergence. import_graph gained a path argument so the remedy it names is a thing the tool can actually do.
properties.name: Refuse to write a design over work the shared record already holds
